name: clutch-linear-size-weight-v1
hypothesis: Winning from a larger first sole-survivor disadvantage may carry more Rating weight than a 1v1 win.
definition: sum(X * clutch_1vX for X=1..5)/rounds, exactly the previously tested linear size rule; no per-size coefficients.
control: Original equal-credit clutches/rounds; reuse saved baseline model and CV metrics.
fixed: All other available raw families unchanged: 8-second trade differential, original KOST and separate survival, kills beyond first, opening differential, objectives excluded; ridge alpha 1.
split: 299 clean pre-August training rows, seven held-out-event folds, then August EWC 32 development rows. Both September events excluded; final NA60 sealed.
decision: One variant only. Require consistent event and August gain before considering replacement; no size-coefficient grid search. Preregistered before fitting.
